:::{#exr-cv-estimate-by-fold}
#### The cross-validation estimate, fold by fold

Rewrite the [cross-validation estimate](#def-cv-estimate) @eq-cv-estimate
as $1/\nobs$ times a double sum:
an outer sum over the fold numbers $\ifold = 1, \ldots, \nfolds$
and an inner sum over the observations $\iobs$ in [fold](#def-folds) $\fold{\ifold}$.

:::
